en: The sea has come in over the sand. Whatever lay here is under the water.
text: Marea a intrat peste nisip. Orice se afla aici e sub apă.

en: A little Shoal Salt was here, but there's none left now.
text: Aici era puțină Sare de Mal, dar acum nu a mai rămas deloc.
